The wizard Arvel meets his end at the hands of his fiancée, Seraphina, who would later become the emperor's mistress and a notorious villainess. However, when he comes to, he finds himself face-to-face with a young Seraphina! Astonishingly, he has returned to the body of his 13-year-old self. Seeing the young and still innocent Seraphina, Arvel decides he will help her become a proper lady and save his own life in the process. To start, he must find a way to prevent the death of his brother, Shou, who was once engaged to Seraphina. However, the situation is far from simple, as he must contend with Seraphina's neglectful family, other men vying for the beautiful Seraphina's attention, and a web of conflicting plots. synopsis: A pure love story between two people with a 50cm height difference and mismatched appearances and personalities. The new part-timer is... a child!?!? Osaki-san is tall and has a poker face, making her seem intimidating at first glance, but she's actually shy and kind. The new employee who comes to Osaki-san's workplace is Komori-san, who is only 147cm tall and very friendly. These two, who are complete opposites in appearance and personality, find themselves drawn to each other...!? Osaki-san is clumsy and a crybaby, yet a go-getter, and Komori-san is oblivious, laid-back, and a gentle, introverted type. What will become of the love between these two, who are complete opposites and have a 50cm height difference...? This is the first installment of a hilarious and heartwarming survival-of-the-fittest (?) romantic comedy about these two quirky girls. (Source: Kadokawa, translated) Note: Originally self-published on the author's Twitter, it was later acquired by Kadokawa who released the first volume on May 11, 2026.

They used to be quite close, but as their respective paths in life took shape, their relationship became distant and awkward, almost as if they were strangers. In fact, ever since their days at the taekwondo dojo, Hae-Jin has always looked up to Ki-Hyeok, and finally, at the start of their freshman year of high school, the two reunite in the same school and the same class. However, Ki-Hyuk appears in such a disheveled state that he shatters Hae-Jin’s expectations. Despite this, Hae-Jin’s feelings for Ki-Hyeok refused to fade; instead, his obsession and determination kicked in, and he resolved to restore the object of her admiration to his former glory with her own hands. And so, Hae-Jin’s inexplicable obsession with Ki-Hyeok— his grand transformation project—began. (Source: KakaoPage, translated) Note: The first story in the Sachungi: Neoreul Saenggakaneun Bom (사춘기: 너를 생각하는 봄) Collection.
